review_result.summary: The code provided is a basic implementation of a scientific calculator, but it has several issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The use of eval() function can pose a significant security risk as it can evaluate any JavaScript code, making it vulnerable to code injection attacks.
issues.suggestion: Use a safer alternative, such as a parsing library or a custom implementation of a mathematical expression evaluator.

issues.description: The calculator does not handle invalid input, such as multiple operators in a row or invalid characters.
issues.suggestion: Add input validation to handle such cases and prevent the calculator from producing incorrect results or crashing.

issues.description: The code uses a switch statement with many cases, which can be hard to read and maintain.
issues.suggestion: Consider using an object-based approach or a more modular design to improve code readability and maintainability.

issues.description: The code uses alert() function to display the calculation history, which can be intrusive and not user-friendly.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a more modern and user-friendly approach, such as displaying the history in a separate section of the calculator or using a toast notification.
